decisions.text: Confirm OPT-2 as the chosen option at promotion (promote.py --option OPT-2). This record assesses the assistant's provisional recommendation only; nothing here is binding.

Residual of OQ-11/AC-7: a creator who explicitly sets themselves as owner looks the same as the default owner, so that case is round-robin assigned. Accept this, as OQ-11's wording implies, or state otherwise.

How 'owner is still the creator' is tested in before insert (Inferred: CreatedById is not yet set there, so the check is OwnerId against UserInfo.getUserId()); new tests must cover explicit owner kept and default owner assigned.
Locking approach for the single Round_Robin_State__c row (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE or other) so concurrent saves do not read the same position, and its contention at peak volume.

CaseAccountSummaryController_Test.cls:64 inserts a Case with the default owner, so it runs assignment and depends on org Escalation_Agents membership: leave it, set agentPoolOverride, or set an explicit owner.
Which case creators beyond Service_Agent and Team_Lead (integration, automated users) create cases with the default owner and so need access to Round_Robin_State__c under user-mode DML.
Precedence against case assignment rules or Omni-Channel routing (OQ-10): assignment rules run after triggers and can overwrite the owner set in before insert.
Zero hits in index for Logger: whether to add a project logger for assignment failures, given the apex-no-system-debug rule.

unknowns: OQ-8 (deferred, Salesforce Admin): case volumes per day, at peak and in bulk loads; assignee visibility under org sharing settings.
OQ-10 (deferred, Salesforce Admin): whether case assignment rules, Omni-Channel or another tool sets the owner of new cases, and which wins.

Unverifiable (Salesforce Admin, with OQ-10): Web-to-Case and Email-to-Case set the default owner from org settings, not from the running user, so under AC-7 those cases may never match 'owner is still the creator' and may not be round-robin assigned.
Escalation_Agents queue membership is org data; no members in source, so the real pool size is unknown.
Linked parent feature text was not supplied; scope boundary taken from the confirmed story only.
No data-dictionary extract: the type of Round_Robin_State__c.Last_Assigned_User__c is assumed (User lookup) and capped at Inferred.
CaseTrigger active status is not in the index (story EC-1).
No managed-package namespace applies: index stamp namespaces is empty and no seed term maps to LLC_BI, nFORCE, nFUSE, nRetail or FinServ.
